notes: The editor glosses «- المعنى قريب -» and «- يعني ابن حباب -» are left out; the attached «و» of «وابن أبي زياد» is dropped.
Sa'id ibn al-As asks inside Abu Aisha's account: he is in the scene, not a link. Abu Musa is the last link because his words are the saying; Hudhayfa's «صدق» is not a link.
